name: Shadowthread Cave
summary: In Shadowthread Cave, spiders now threaten the young kaldorei near Aldrassil. The cave lies beneath Shadowglen’s northwest cliffs.

sections.title: A Brood Growing Restless
sections.body: In Shadowglen’s shaded northwest, Shadowthread Cave shelters Teldrassil’s giant spiders. Once they lived quietly among the World Tree’s young boughs. Now the brood guards its territory fiercely. Webwood silk chokes the stone corridors, and the spiders threaten young kaldorei who venture beyond Aldrassil.

sections.title: Githyiss the Vile
sections.body: Githyiss the Vile rules Shadowthread Cave’s deepest recesses. The monstrous broodmother is far more ferocious than the common webwood crawlers. Young night elf sentinels and druids enter the cave to curb the infestation and slay her. Corruption touches Teldrassil’s wildlife, and the sanctuary of Shadowglen is at risk.

faq.answer: Shadowthread Cave lies in Shadowglen’s northwest corner, against the rocky hillside at the edge of Teldrassil’s night elf starting valley.

faq.q: Why are the spiders in the cave so aggressive?
faq.answer: Spiders have always dwelled in Shadowthread Cave, but a foul sickness and growing imbalance across Teldrassil have driven local wildlife mad. The webwood spiders have become exceptionally violent.
Githyiss the Vile is a massive, venomous webwood spider matriarch in the deepest part of Shadowthread Cave. She is the mother of the aggressive brood threatening young kaldorei in Shadowglen.

faq.q: What makes the cave valuable despite the danger?
faq.answer: Dense layers of naturally spun webwood silk fill the cave. In its dark chambers, the arachnids weave this valuable, resilient crafting material in great numbers.

angles.text: As a young night elf, you face an early trial in defending your sacred home from creeping corruption. Clear Shadowthread Cave and slay Githyiss the Vile.
As a druid, you can read the Webwood brood’s unchecked aggression as a troubling sign. Teldrassil’s natural harmony is deeply disturbed.
